{{Quote|Right after the starting grid we turn into ''Splinter Pass''. One nudge from another racer and you'll end up with a mouth full of durasteel.|Kidd Kareen, a Podracer pilot, describes Splinter Pass|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Splinter Pass''' was the opening stretch of a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], known as the [[Mon Gazza Maze/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]]. Splinter Pass was a large, flat expanse of land dotted with spiked [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] pillars and totems that were difficult to navigate. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] could easily lose track of where they were going and crash, as even the slightest bump from another racer could send a pilot barreling toward one of the sturdy pillars.<ref name="CC" />

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]'' to around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] event known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was given a brief description of Splinter Pass by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Kidd Kareen]]. Tano later participated in a Maze qualifier and passed through the area while competing against other pilots, such as [[San Maxus]] and [[Raido]]. Tano, Maxus, and Kareen later passed through the area again during the actual Maze.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Splinter Pass appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]'', which was written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="CC" /> on [[December 31]], [[2008]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-831/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars--Crash-Course|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars--Crash Course}}</ref>
